IC1: 1. Decrease in size of the designated target ulcer(s) by ≥ 30% during the 7-day screening period
IC2: 2. Cannot tolerate or comply with compression therapy.
IC3: 3. An ulcer which shows signs of severe clinical infection, defined as pus oozing from the ulcer site
IC4: 4. An ulcer positive for β-hemolytic streptococci upon culture
IC5: 5. The ulcer [AND] has > 50% slough, significant necrotic tissue [OR], bone [OR], tendon [OR], or capsule exposure [OR] or avascular ulcer beds
IC6: 6. Is highly exuding (i.e. requires daily change of dressing)
IC9: 9. Patients with clinically significant [AND] medical conditions as determined by the investigator including renal [OR], hepatic [OR], hematologic [OR], neurologic [OR] or immune disease. Examples include but are not limited to:
IC10: 1. Renal insufficiency [AND] as an estimated GFR which is < 30 mL/min/1.7m2
IC11: 2. Abnormal blood biochemistry defined as 3 times that of the upper limit of the normal range.
IC12: 3. Hepatic insufficiency defined as total bilirubin [OR] > 2 mg/dL or serum albumin < 25 g/L
IC17: 10. Presence of an active systemic [OR] or local cancer [OR] or tumor of any kind [AND] ([NOT] with the exception of non-melanoma skin cancer)
IC18: 11. Patients with severe rheumatoid arthritis [OR] (with more than 20 persistently inflamed joints, or below lower normal limit blood albumin level, or evidence of bone and cartilage damage on x-ray, or inflammation in tissues other than joints) and other collagen vascular diseases.
IC19: 12. Patients with active connective tissue disease
IC20: 13. Treatment [OR] with systemic corticosteroids (>15 mg/day), or current immunosuppressive agents
IC21: 14. Previous [OR] or current radiation therapy or likelihood to receive this therapy during study participation
IC23: 16. Known prior inability or unavailability to complete required study visits during study participation
IC24: 17. Significant peripheral edema as per investigator's discretion
IC25: 18. A psychiatric condition [OR] (e.g., suicidal ideation) or chronic alcohol [OR] or drug abuse problem, determined from the patient's medical history, which, in the opinion of the investigator, may pose a threat to patient compliance
IC26: 19. Use of a platelet-derived growth factor within 28 days before screening
IC27: 20. Use of any investigational [OR] drug or therapy within 28 days before screening
IC28: 21. Has any other factor which may, in the opinion of the investigator, compromise participation and/or follow-up in the study
